hooks.name: commit-guard
hooks.description: Before any shell command: block git push, gh repo create, vercel, netlify deploy, modal deploy/serve/run and npm publish unless the user set STITCHFORM_GO=1; on git commit, run typecheck, tests (reduced fast-check runs) and repo checks (.kiro not ignored, MIT LICENSE, no .env or secrets, no em dashes in docs, SAMPLE labels, dependencies listed in README Pre-existing work). Fails closed after an internal 100 s deadline.
